phases.title: The Approach
phases.description: The opposing forces take up positions around Dunkeld. Troop placements in this phase should show the initial dispositions, rather than the later street fighting.

phases.title: The Assault
phases.description: Jacobite forces begin their attack on the Government positions. Use this phase for the first advances, firing positions and artillery placements.

phases.title: Street Fighting
phases.time_label: As the fighting moves into the town
phases.description: The fighting spreads into Dunkeld. Troop positions change, defensive points become important, and smoke and fire effects can appear where supported by the evidence.

phases.title: The Aftermath
phases.description: The fighting has ended. Show the forces withdrawing or regrouping, with any surviving fires and damage represented in the affected parts of the town.
